newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen climbing regardless of dollar.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen climbing regardless of dollar.

text.p: Danish share prices rose on Wednesday morning and dealers expected the KFX index to hit a record high for the 12th consecutive trading, regardless of a slight weakening in the dollar.
At 0800 GMT the KFX top-20 index was up 0.11 point from Tuesday's close, to 188.07 and its August future rose 0.90 point to 189.60.

Tele Danmark was down three crowns to 385.00 but ahead of a New York close equivalent to 379 crowns. Novo Nordisk, also listed on Wall Street, traded at 767 crowns, well below its New York close of 780.00. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
